new_libraries.name: Tanglish Converter
new_libraries.author: Oshan Dissanayaka
new_libraries.sentence: Converts Tamil (UTF-8) text to Tanglish - readable English letters - for displays and fonts that can't draw Tamil.
new_libraries.paragraph: Strings, buffers (no heap), any Stream (Serial, SD files, network) or as a Print wrapper around a display: print Tamil, see Tanglish. Follows spoken Tamil (murugan, thangam, nandri), handles vowel signs, pulli and split vowel signs. Casual, simple or phonetic style. Works on AVR, ESP32, ESP8266, RP2040, STM32 and more.

library.name: thinger.io
library.author: Alvaro Luis Bustamante <alvarolb@thinger.io>
library.sentence: Arduino library for IOTMP protocol used on Thinger.io IOT Platform.
library.paragraph: Thinger.io is an open source platform for the Internet of Things. It will allow connecting your things or devices for remote sensing and actuating using the protocol IOTMP. Working with several devices like ESP8266, ESP32, Arduino Ethernet, Arduino Wifi, Arduino MKR1000, Arduino MKR1010, Arduino Nano RP2040 Connect, Arduino Nano 33 IOT, Arduino MKRNB1500, Arduino GSM1400, Arduino Portenta, Arduino Opta, Arduino R4, Arduino Yun, Adafruit CC3000, Arduino + GSM Modules, Texas Instruments CC3200, ENC28J60, LinkIt ONE.
